|colspan="6" align="left"|'''Notes:'''<br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|ambassador|1}} At the ambassador's meeting, Olivier and Teheiura had to vote on one castaway to eliminate. They both decided to<br />vote out Maxime.<br />
{{note|idol|2}} A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.<br />
{{note|idol2|3}} A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played; however, no votes were cast against its user.<br />
{{note|final4|4}} At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Ella came in last and was eliminated.
{{refend}}
